```repl
import re
lines = [l for l in context.split('\n') if l.strip()]
recs = []
for l in lines:
    est = re.search(r'estimated=(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', l).group(1)
    dl = re.search(r'delivered=(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', l).group(1)
    rv = re.search(r'review=(\d)/5 "(.*)"', l)
    recs.append(dict(line=l, est=est, dl=dl, score=rv.group(1), text=rv.group(2), ok=dl <= est))
ontime = [r for r in recs if r['ok']]
print(len(ontime), len(recs))
labels = {}
for i in range(0, len(ontime), 45):
    chunk = ontime[i:i+45]
    prompt = ("Classify each Portuguese review comment as one letter: d (delivery complaint: late, not received, damaged in transit), "
              "p (product complaint: quality, defect, broken, wrong size/colour, not as described), "
              "s (seller service: communication, refund, cancellation, wrong or missing items sent, invoice), "
              "g (positive/satisfied, no real complaint), o (other/vague/price/shipping cost). "
              "Answer one line per item in the form '<number>: <letter>'.\n\n")
    prompt += "\n".join(f"{j+1}. {r['text']}" for j, r in enumerate(chunk))
    out = llm_query(prompt)
    for line in out.split('\n'):
        m = re.match(r'\s*(\d+)\s*[:.)-]\s*([dpsgo])', line)
        if m:
            idx = i + int(m.group(1)) - 1
            if 0 <= idx < len(ontime):
                labels[idx] = m.group(2)
cnt = {}
for k, v in labels.items():
    cnt[v] = cnt.get(v, 0) + 1
print(len(labels), cnt)
pc = cnt.get('p', 0)
print(round(100 * pc / len(ontime), 1))
```
